Offline background removal (runs in the browser, nothing is uploaded).
- ort.min.js, ort-wasm-simd-threaded.*  : ONNX Runtime Web 1.20.1, MIT licence, Microsoft.
- silueta.onnx : U2-Net based portrait model reduced to 43 MB (U2-Net: Apache-2.0, Xuebin Qin et al.), from the rembg project releases (MIT).
- u2netp.onnx  : U2-Net small, 4.6 MB (Apache-2.0). Used when silueta.onnx is not present.
